package.name: x30_mapping
package.description: The site maps of the X30 (the ROS Noetic port of dharma_mapping): an occupancy grid built from FAST-LIO's registered scans along the localized pose, saved per site with its fiducials and routes; a site manager that owns the active site, publishes /map and runs mapping sessions with x30_localization; and a route recorder for the patrol routes and their stop points.
